parsed.rationale: All four `SequentialMockSession` type-alias-objects reside in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and are nested inside test classes (`iTunesArtworkServiceTests`, `LastFMArtworkServiceTests`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests`). Although the pipeline reports `is_test: false` on every record, the file path under `Tests/ArtworkTests/` and the `*Tests.*` qualified names are unambiguous evidence of test-fixture context. Each alias is scoped to its enclosing test class, so the repetition is intentional isolation — each test suite owns its own local `SequentialMockSession` alias to avoid cross-suite coupling. Lifting these into a shared location would couple independent test suites and obscure which mock session belongs to which service under test.
